annotations.title: Prepare a withdrawal from a contract for the person to confirm

description: Never withdraws anything by itself. Lists the person's recent purchases, top-ups, gift cards and storage plans and returns a link to the form "Withdraw from contract" on bitsound.com/withdrawal with the contract already chosen. The person checks the statement and sends it with "Confirm withdrawal" in the browser. Music purchases where the person agreed to the immediate download are usually no longer withdrawable; Bitsound checks every withdrawal.
